## Verdict
needs-revision

## Concerns
- `claim-1` certifies the degreewise Pieri matrices and their Smith data only under the stipulated interval presentation. The report itself states that this presentation is not grounded in the supplied record.
- The artifact establishes \(Q\cong\mathbb Z^6\) for that model, but it does not compute the quotient coordinates or lattice indices of the two proposed six-element families.
- The specialization of the source families to
  \(\{s_{22},s_{32},s_{33},s_{42},s_{43},s_{44}\}\) and
  \(\{s_{22},s_{221},s_{222},s_{2211},s_{2221},s_{2222}\}\)
  remains conditional. Therefore the requested determination that both map to integral bases is not established.
- `claim-2` correctly limits the finite computation, but does not repair the missing case-specific conclusion.

## Unresolved certificates
- [proof-attempt] Supply the exact case-specific interval presentation and specialized source-family formulas, then give exact quotient-coordinate matrices or unimodular minors/SNF certificates proving that each six-element family maps to a \(\mathbb Z\)-basis of \(Q\).
